description:
One output variable's summary as a table: the coordinate columns (one per dim), then
one column per statistic (``mean``, ``hdi_90_lower``, ...). Dates are ISO text.
``period``: the variable is a circular output (``OutputDecl.circular``), summarised on the
circle (see the field). ``dims`` and ``time_dim`` say which columns are coordinates and
which one is time; a server that predates them leaves both out. ``plots``: the recipe ids
of the run's rendered plots (``plots.json``) that draw this variable, so a client can show
them next to the table.

dims.description: The coordinate columns (the leading columns); the rest are statistics
dims.title: Dims

period.description: Set for a circular output (an angle that wraps at one turn, in the output's units): the statistics are on the circle. `mean` is the circular mean, the intervals are centred on it, and every value is in [0, period). An interval with lower > upper crosses the seam (from 350 to 10 degrees)
period.title: Period

plots.description: Recipe ids of the run's plots that draw this output (sci.area_map, core.roc_pr, ...)
plots.title: Plots

time_dim.description: The dim that is time, when there is one
time_dim.title: Time Dim

title: ScoreSummaryTable
